definitions.gloss: setting up, installation, preparation of a site
definitions.explanation: The act of setting up a camp, tent, event venue, or facility. Often used for temporary installations.

examples.japanese: ⟦テント→テント：03859_tento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{設営|せつえい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{設営|せつえい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}った→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧。
examples.english: I helped set up the venue.

examples.japanese: ⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦{前日|ぜんじつ}→前日：03108_zenjitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{設営|せつえい}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: All staff worked together on setup the day before the event.

notes:
{設営|せつえい} means setting up or installing a temporary facility, camp, venue, or similar structure. It combines {設|せつ} (establish) with {営|えい} (operate/camp).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦テント→テント：03859_tento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{設営|せつえい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to set up a tent
- ⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{設営|せつえい}: venue setup
- {設営|せつえい}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧: setup work
- ⟦{基地|きち}→基地：03982_kichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{設営|せつえい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to set up a base
- {設営|せつえい}⟦{班|はん}→班：03697_han⟧: setup team/crew

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{撤収|てっしゅう}→撤収：12922_tesshuu⟧: teardown, striking camp, withdrawal

USAGE:
Often used for temporary installations (events, camping, military operations). For permanent construction, ⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧ or ⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧ are more appropriate.
